name: Mermaid (Mat)
summary: Seated with legs folded to one side, reach up and over into a side stretch.
steps: Sit with both legs folded to one side, or cross-legged.
Breathe in to lift one arm up by the ear.
Breathe out to reach up and over to the side, the other hand resting on the mat.
Breathe in to return; change sides.

layers.title: Add a twist
layers.text: Turn the chest to the floor at the far point.

layers.title: Hold a ball
layers.text: Both hands overhead on a ball.

modifications: Sit cross-legged or on a block.
cues:
Both sit bones stay down.
Reach up before you go over.
Top shoulder away from the ear.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
